bugs.expected: Delete removes the selected clip (SRW-24: clip removed, gap left) and ArrowRight nudges the selected clip; the marker is untouched. The task (R10, MU8) says: 'Then the clip has focus/selection with the marker unfocused'.
bugs.actual: The clip click does not take focus away from the marker flag. Delete deletes the MARKER (status 'მარკერი «Marker 1» წაიშალა.', clips 1, markers 0) and the clip stays; ArrowRight does not nudge the selected clip (clip start 0.000 before and after). Reproduced at 1440x900 and 1280x720. Control: with focus blurred first, the same click+Delete removes the clip and keeps the marker. Every Add leaves focus on the flag, so this is the normal flow: add a marker, click a clip, press Delete.
bugs.evidence: c-round-72/tools/dbg3.cjs (control vs marker-focused), dbg2.cjs, dbg6.cjs; c-round-72/bug-b72-1-1280.txt. Not covered by A's tests: mutation h (remove the window-branch guard) survives, and MU8 does not click a clip after a marker has focus. Suggested fix direction for B: make a clip/lane pointerdown move focus off the marker (or have the marker handler/exclusions act only while the marker really is the interaction target, e.g. clear focus on clip select), and add a UI test: marker focused, click clip, Delete removes the clip.
